integrity: All claims and limitations are contained in the accompanying proof. Finite test programs corroborate but do not independently prove the infinite assertions. No scientific priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The marked-square theorem needs a fresh marker and avoidance of the doubled endpoint digram. The d-bonacci corollary covers only the initial iterates through d+1; the binary d=2 instance is previously known. A covering implicit formulation may exist outside examined sources.
title: Marked-square net-occurrence rigidity and an initial d-bonacci transition
